summary.source: Fresh Session 83 live-code audit using product, game-loop, mobile interaction, public stats, Obelisk migration, observability-honesty, rendered-pixel, and release-gate lenses. Premises were checked against source, tests, live Studio checkers, current hosted receipts, the Obelisk rollout contract, and durable project decisions.
summary.qualityBar: L2 by default: one canonical authority, player-visible payoff, deterministic focused tests, no fabricated community activity or identity claims, dark/light desktop/mobile rendered proof for touched UI, stable staging before direct-main publication, and launchReady preserved false.

profile.rubric: product rubric plus game-medium overlay: vivid General Manager agency, source-derived memory, touch and keyboard parity, privacy, static/local-first behavior, public stats honesty, Obelisk identity boundaries, and public-app release gates
profile.staging: stable Cloudflare Pages must prove the exact immutable candidate before direct-to-main publication; backend deployment is required only when backend source changes
profile.source: arc-profile registry authority, Session 83 startup brief, 29,981-token code sample, exact grep/read preverification, game-loop review, app-release gate matrix, live CANON-054 checker, live Obelisk migration cargo, canon conformance, and current CI

gameLoopReview.evidence: Code-contract review only. No consented cohort or docs/PLAYTESTS evidence exists, and public SOUL intentionally withholds private criteria, so these scores do not claim measured fun, retention, or complete private-soul conformance.

launchHolds: SHA-bound public-launch approval distinct from deploy authorization
registered and end-to-end verified Obelisk Passport v2 relying party before any account-bearing flow

recommendedMoves: Make identity absence explicit and safe: quarantine the obsolete Passport v1 samples, declare external Obelisk architecture, and keep the status honestly not-integrated until a registered v2 flow is proven.
Turn existing franchise history into weekly decision texture by bringing the last receipted meeting into the tactical brief without implying prediction or causality.

Complete input and reporting parity: let touch users drive the existing Sim-Watch director directly, and bind the public stats tile, deep page, and Analytica consumer to one privacy-bounded feed contract.

preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected by CANON-031 and GAME_LOOP. CANON-054 structure can be repaired without inventing adoption, retention, or player activity.

preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected by CANON-045. The current game is anonymous, the required v2 relying-party registration is unavailable locally, and obsolete v1 samples are not integration evidence.

preverifiedSkips.reason: Rejected as a premise error. The canonical public entry is green and the direct-game deep-link remains an honest separate optimization diagnostic; changing boot semantics needs its own measured implementation.

preverifiedSkips.reason: Founder-direction-gated in the durable decision record; this audit cannot invent terminal product canon.

items.title: Replace misleading Passport v1 samples with one truthful Obelisk v2 boundary
executionEvidence: PROJECT_STATUS declares external + not-integrated + no local auth
items.premise: The live Obelisk migration contract requires OpenID Connect Authorization Code with SHA-256 PKCE, while this repository carried duplicate Passport v1 browser query-token callbacks and a project-local verify-session sample. Nothing imported them, but their presence could be mistaken for a supported integration; PROJECT_STATUS declared no architecture at all.
evidence: live Obelisk migration cargo digest ad951688
obelisk-passport and src duplicate v1 artifacts
items.constraint: No local auth, URL query identity token, browser client secret, or claim of live integration. Account-bearing flows remain unavailable until Obelisk registers and verifies a Passport v2 public-client flow end to end.
verification: public-safe boundary names OIDC Authorization Code + SHA-256 PKCE
structured status remains not-integrated and localAuth false

L1.recipe: Delete duplicate v1 samples and record that the anonymous product has no authentication surface.

L2.recipe: Quarantine every Passport v1 token/callback artifact, declare external Obelisk architecture and an honestly not-integrated v2 PKCE boundary in structured status and public-safe documentation, regression-test the absence of local auth, and request relying-party registration through Studio Ark.

L3.recipe: L2 plus registered Passport v2 discovery, PKCE login/logout/session flows, cross-device verification, and signed human/agent receipts after the required capability becomes available.

items.category: Observability honesty / feedback loop / ecosystem integration
items.title: Bind the homepage showcase, stats atlas, and Analytica ingest to one live contract
executionEvidence: live CANON-054 checker conform with zero findings
six analyzed metrics and a curated three-metric showcase
items.premise: The public Community Stats UI already rendered a live homepage pulse and deeper /stats page, but stats-surface.json omitted showcase IDs, a numeric liveness promise, refresh mechanism, Analytica Feed v1 identity, and explicit aggregate-only privacy. The Studio checker therefore saw four structural gaps despite the live UI.
items.constraint: The descriptor reports structure and analysis affordances, never truthfulness or adoption. No synthetic activity, unbanded small counts, per-visitor query, or duplicate founder feed is allowed.
verification: three showcase IDs resolve to six analyzed metrics
30-second poll and aggregate-only privacy are explicit

L1.recipe: Add the exact missing descriptor fields that already match the browser and server behavior.

L2.recipe: Make stats-surface.json the single privacy-bounded Analytica Feed v1 contract for a curated three-metric homepage showcase, a deeper six-metric atlas, explicit 30-second polling, aggregate-only handling, and structural conformance tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus signed freshness receipts and an Ark-fed portfolio consumer that proves all three surfaces read the identical artifact fingerprint.

items.category: Game depth / weekly decision texture / immersion
items.title: Bring the last receipted meeting into this week's tactical room
executionEvidence: source-derived last score and recent sample
desktop/mobile dark/light rendered proof uses fictional OS/DMW labels and states the no-causality boundary
items.premise: Rivalry DNA already retains every head-to-head result and the dashboard exposes that authority, but the weekly tactical brief reads only current ratings, scheme, aggression, and injuries. A rematch therefore feels identical to a first meeting even when the franchise has exact shared history.
items.constraint: Use only receipted score/history data, keep missing history invisible, distinguish a bounded recent sample from an all-time record, escape rendered text, and state that history is neither prediction nor causation.
verification: home/away score orientation is controlled-team correct
empty and malformed histories fail closed
brief renders last meeting, recent sample, and disclaimer in both themes

L1.recipe: Show the last receipted score beside the current opponent read.

L2.recipe: Derive one Rematch Memory from the canonical rivalry ledger, orient the score to the controlled team, add a bounded recent W-L-T sample and explicit non-predictive disclaimer, then render it as subordinate tactical context with focused tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus join prior tactic receipts and exact box-score deltas into a film-study comparison without awarding bonuses or claiming those choices caused results.

items.category: Mobile UI UX / input parity / session engagement
items.title: Let touch players direct Sim-Watch without hunting tiny transport controls
executionEvidence: authentic browser touch transport advanced 128→129 and rewound 129→128 through the existing director
desktop/mobile dark/light rendered proof confirmed the hint, reachable ticker launch, and mobile overlay stacking
items.premise: Sim-Watch exposes buttons and keyboard arrows but no pointer or touch gesture. On a 390px viewport the live play log is the largest target, yet a tablet or phone player must reach the compact 34px controls to step through key plays.
evidence: repo-wide source search found no pointer/touch listener
items.constraint: Reuse the existing previous/next controller, accept touch and pen only, preserve vertical scrolling, ignore short/off-axis gestures, keep buttons and keyboard fully functional, and never add a second playback state machine.
verification: left advances and right rewinds deterministically
vertical and short gestures do nothing
desktop/mobile dark/light overlay pixels remain readable

L1.recipe: Map a minimum-distance horizontal swipe on the play log to existing previous/next actions.

L2.recipe: Add idempotent touch/pen swipe transport with deterministic direction resolution, off-axis rejection, pan-y preservation, a concise discoverability hint, and behavioral tests while retaining button and keyboard parity.

L3.recipe: L2 plus an optional reduced-motion-safe drag preview and setting-respecting haptic confirmation driven by the same controller snapshot.

innovationCandidates.novelty: Turns a latent cross-season rivalry ledger into contextual weekly film without adding a reward system.
Makes the play log itself the transport surface while retaining vertical-scroll intent.
One privacy-bounded descriptor serves public headline, deep analysis, and portfolio intelligence.
A server-independent first-paint contract shell could eliminate the deep-link LCP handoff, but needs dedicated measured boot-sequence work.
Compare prior and current tactic receipts without turning correlation into a game bonus or prediction.
Rendered proof exposed canonical engine IDs inside the fictional league; every new tactical label now resolves through the public team identity.
The same rendered session exposed object-shaped standings leaking as [object Object]; one normalizer now protects deadline headlines and partner terms.
Two competing ticker listeners made the broadcast unreachable; the launch now has one ordered box-score-plus-broadcast authority.

secondOrderImprovements: Resolved fictional-team identity labels consistently across tactical reads, option copy, and rematch memory.
Normalized object-shaped standing identities before constructing trade-deadline recommendations.
Collapsed duplicate ticker listeners into one ordered Sim-Watch launch path.
Made the tactical composer scroll safely on mobile and corrected light-theme tactic-card contrast.
Raised Sim-Watch above the mobile decision deck and expanded it to the usable mobile viewport.
